Promotion requires an exact-source execution path or authoritative unquantized weights, then a fresh five-run sweep. Current draft evidence is listed below.

## Why This Benchmark Is Included

Established small-vocabulary audio classification task.

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Classroom value** | Adds audio preprocessing and depthwise-separable convolution. |
| **Systems behavior** | Small-tensor convolution, feature extraction, and latency sensitivity. |
| **Benchmark lineage** | Direct MLPerf Tiny workload inheritance. |
| **Model choice** | DS-CNN is fixed by the upstream MLPerf Tiny contract. |
| **Dataset choice** | Speech Commands v2 is fixed by the upstream contract. |
| **Quality metric** | Top-1 accuracy and the threshold are fixed upstream. |
| **Published baseline** | MLPerf Tiny reference quality contract |
| **Alternative rejected** | Project-defined audio tasks would lose MLPerf comparability. |

## Authoritative Sources and Adaptation

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Authority** | MLCommons MLPerf Tiny and EEMBC |
| **Model repository** | [open source](https://github.com/mlcommons/tiny) |
| **Model commit** | `1afd2c9820f795965a6134facd0b4dfae41ef23f` |
| **Evaluation repository** | [open source](https://github.com/eembc/benchmark-runner-ml) |
| **Evaluation commit** | `cf7c2f2634608a7c0ea7458ab7cb3379f2863424` |

**Adaptation boundary:** Fused weights are read from the pinned MLCommons TFLite artifact and loaded into the equivalent PyTorch DS-CNN inference graph. The fixed EEMBC INT8 MFCC examples are dequantized with the source model input parameters. The upstream float-input TFLite graph stores convolution kernels with dynamic-range INT8 quantization, so the dequantized PyTorch execution preserves topology and passes the inherited quality gate but is not bitwise or prediction-exact with every LiteRT kernel.

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload keyword-spotting --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload keyword-spotting --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload keyword-spotting --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload keyword-spotting --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

## Candidate Quality Target

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | top1_accuracy |
| **Target** | 0.9 |
| **Direction** | higher |
| **Target kind** | inherited acceptance gate |
| **Target basis** | mlcommons_derived |
| **Tolerance** | 0.0 |
| **Reference runs** | 0 |

**Reviewer notes:**

- The 90% threshold and 1,000-example MFCC evaluation contract are inherited from MLPerf Tiny.
- A full-set LiteRT 2.1.6 audit found 7 of 1,000 top-1 disagreements against XNNPACK and 5 against the builtin kernels. PyTorch scores 90.2%, while LiteRT scores 90.0% and 90.5%, respectively; every path passes the inherited 90% gate, but strict prediction parity is not established.
- The review decision classifies the PyTorch conversion as quality-preserving but nonidentical. It remains useful for education, but it is not promotion eligible. Promotion requires exact-source execution or authoritative unquantized weights, followed by a fresh multi-run sweep. No disagreement tolerance is implied.
- Each execution performs 1,000 untimed accuracy-set passes to establish a repeatable device state, then measures 2,000 unchanged passes; quality is computed from the first measured pass only.

## Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Within-run measurement protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Primary metric** | inference_seconds |
| **Scenario** | offline |
| **Timing scope** | 2,000 repetitions of the complete 1,000-example accuracy set after model, data, and the declared 1,000-pass device warmup are complete |
| **Included phases** | batched PyTorch model execution |
| **Excluded phases** | asset fetching, TFLite weight parsing and PyTorch model construction, data-file loading and INT8 input dequantization, 1,000 untimed complete accuracy-set passes after one shape warmup for each observed batch shape, accuracy computation, checkpoint, report, and provenance serialization |
| **Device synchronization** | synchronize immediately before and after the measured inference region |
| **Outer reference runs** | 5 |
| **Outer preconditioning runs** | 0 |
| **Outer inter execution cooldown seconds** | 5 |
| **Repeatability metric** | inference_seconds |
| **Repeatability limit** | 0.05 |
